variables.name: border/low
variables.description: Default border. Opacity-based: adapts to any surface. Light: Black/Alpha/15, Dark: White/Alpha/15.

variables.name: icon/muted
variables.description: Decorative/secondary icon colour. Below WCAG AA — intentional for visual hierarchy. DO NOT use for interactive, informational, or standalone icons. Pair with a visible label or use icon/default instead. Alpha-based to match text/disabled and stay consistent across surfaces.

variables.name: Primary/Dark
variables.description: Brand primary scale step 400 — aliases to the active brand hue

variables.name: Primary/Core
variables.description: Brand primary scale step 500 — aliases to the active brand hue

variables.name: input/surface
variables.description: Input field background. White by default, sunken/grey when disabled.

variables.name: input/border
variables.description: Input border. Thickens and colour-shifts on hover, focus, and error.

variables.name: input/icon-trailing
variables.description: Trailing icon inside input (clear, reveal password, etc). Muted by default.

variables.name: Black/Alpha/15
variables.description: Black at 15% opacity. Use for border/default opacity equivalent on light surfaces.

variables.name: White/Alpha/15
variables.description: White at 15% opacity. Use for border/default opacity equivalent on dark surfaces.

variables.name: White/Alpha/30
variables.description: White at 25% opacity. Use for border/medium opacity equivalent on dark surfaces.

1364:7707.name: Select
1364:7707.description: Text input. States: default, hover, active, focus, disabled, error. Supports label, hint, and leading/trailing icons.

1368:5654.name: Label/Default
1368:5654.description: Buttons, form labels, navigation items, UI controls
